_note: The AI diagrams' logos, moved from cloud-native-ref's icon library (docs/architecture/icons/) with the diagrams that use them. PNG, not SVG: headless drawio export does not render SVG data URIs. Embed with image=data:image/png,<base64> -- a comma, not ';base64,', which terminates the style value. The host's scripts/docs/diagram-icons.py style <name> emits the cell style for a host icon; a host logo an AI diagram uses (cilium, crossplane, ...) stays in the host library.
